# Equipment and Weapon Permits Guide
The approval of permits is a privilege, not a right, and no one is obligated to approve any permit. \nPermits are invalid if not kept on their owner's person.
For the ease of your time and the time of others, please seek required permit approval in the following order; \nItem Orgin, [color=#fcdf03]Relevant Leader[/color], [color=#fcdf03]Captain[/color], [color=#86d420]Central Command[/color].
A [bold][color=#fcdf03]Relevant Leader[/color][/bold] is the highest-ranking person of a department or corporation on station for a given approved group. \nWhen seeking a permit for contraband, you must always seek approval from the [color=#fcdf03]Relevant Leader[/color] where the item originated; otherwise, you may seek out any [color=#fcdf03]Relevant Leader[/color].
[bolditalic]E.G.[/bolditalic] [italic]If you obtain a survival knife from [color=#b48b57]Cargo[/color], you need the [color=#b48b57]Quartermaster[/color]'s stamp, and the [color=#ff4242]Warden[/color] or [color=#ff4242]Head of Security[/color]'s stamp because it's a weapon (the [color=#ff4242]Warden[/color] only works in this case because it is Tier Three or below and [color=#ff4242]Security[/color] approved).\nBut if you find the item in maintenance, you could get it approved with only the [color=#ff4242]Head of Security[/color]'s stamp, as they can cover both the department and weapon permit.[/italic]
When choosing between NT-CC Consortium, Affiliated Corporations, or Rival Corporation, use the following guide.
Any item that has at least one NT-CC Consortium Corporation or Department on it, you must seek at least one approval from them, and must seek approval from the item's origin if it has one.
[bolditalic]E.G.[/bolditalic] [italic]If you buy a survival knife from salvage, you need the [color=#963dca]Salvage Lead[/color]'s stamp for its origin, the [color=#b48b57]Quartermaster[/color] or [color=#ff4242]Head of Security[/color]'s stamp because they are a listed NT-CC Consortium department, and the [color=#ff4242]Warden[/color] or [color=#ff4242]Head of Security[/color]'s stamp because it's a weapon (the [color=#ff4242]Warden[/color] only works in this case because it is Tier Three or below and [color=#ff4242]Security[/color] approved).[/italic]
For items without at least one NT-CC Consortium Corporation or Department on it, you only need seek out approval from the [color=#fcdf03]Relevant Leader[/color].
[bolditalic]E.G.[/bolditalic] [italic]If you wanted a brown scavenger beret, you need only the [color=#963dca]Salvage Lead[/color]'s approval.[/italic]
## NT-CC Consortium
- [bold]Tier One:[/bold] Stamped approval from the [color=#fcdf03]Relevant Leader[/color]. - [bold]Tier Two:[/bold] Stamped approval from the [color=#fcdf03]Relevant Leader[/color]. - [bold]Tier Three:[/bold] Stamped approval from the [color=#fcdf03]Relevant Leader[/color]. - [bold]Tier Four:[/bold] Stamped approval from the [color=#fcdf03]Relevant Leader[/color] and [color=#fcdf03]Captain[/color]. - [bold]Tier Five:[/bold] Stamped approval from the [color=#fcdf03]Relevant Leader[/color] and [color=#86d420]Central Command[/color].
## Affiliated Corporations
- [bold]Tier One:[/bold] Stamped approval from the [color=#fcdf03]Relevant Leader[/color]. - [bold]Tier Two:[/bold] Stamped approval from the [color=#fcdf03]Relevant Leader[/color]. - [bold]Tier Three:[/bold] Stamped approval from the [color=#fcdf03]Relevant Leader[/color]. - [bold]Tier Four:[/bold] Stamped approval from the [color=#fcdf03]Relevant Leader[/color] and [color=#fcdf03]Captain[/color]. - [bold]Tier Five:[/bold] Stamped approval from the [color=#fcdf03]Relevant Leader[/color] and [color=#86d420]Central Command[/color].
## Rival Corporations
- [bold]Tier One:[/bold] Stamped approval from the [color=#ff4242]Warden[/color], or the below examples. - [bold]Tier Two:[/bold] Stamped approval from the [color=#ff4242]Warden[/color], or the below examples. - [bold]Tier Three:[/bold] Stamped approval from the [color=#ff4242]Head of Security[/color], or the below examples. - [bold]Tier Four:[/bold] Stamped approval from the [color=#fcdf03]Captain[/color] and [color=#86d420]Central Command[/color]. - [bold]Tier Five:[/bold] Stamped approval from the [color=#fcdf03]Captain[/color] and [color=#86d420]Central Command[/color].
## Weapon Permits and Security Gear
Weapon Permits follow Equipment Permits but need the following additional approvals. \nThe [color=#ff4242]Warden[/color] can authorize any Tier [color=#ff4242]Security Gear[/color] or [color=#ff4242]Security Weapons[/color] where they are listed below without the [color=#ff4242]Head of Security[/color]'s stamp.
- [bold]Tier One:[/bold] Stamped approval from the [color=#ff4242]Warden[/color], or the below examples. - [bold]Tier Two:[/bold] Stamped approval from the [color=#ff4242]Warden[/color], or the below examples. - [bold]Tier Three:[/bold] Stamped approval from the [color=#ff4242]Warden[/color], or the below examples. - [bold]Tier Four:[/bold] Stamped approval from the [color=#ff4242]Head of Security[/color], or the below examples. - [bold]Tier Five:[/bold] Stamped approval from the [color=#fcdf03]Captain[/color] and [color=#ff4242]Head of Security[/color].
